services.desc: Host your next corporate event here at the Ruthe Jackson Center, a premier event venue in the center of the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex! Our state-of-the-art audiovisual equipment, high-speed internet access, and LCD projectors provide the tools you need for successful conferences, team meetings, and special events. Our dedicated Conference Managers are available to ensure every detail of your corporate event is executed flawlessly, making us the top choice for corporate meetings, seminars, and all business events in DFW.
